title: A great way to see a beautiful city
text: Carlos was a brilliant guide! He had so much enthusiasm & knowledge & made the whole tour a really fun experience. So glad we chose to do this - it was the best thing we did while we were in beautiful Barcelona. It was a great way to see so much of the city & Carlos' energy & enthusiasm was a bonus!
author: wendyeI9280WW

title: Great Value and So Much Fun
text: Ronnie took us on a tour of Barcelona with scooters. Our family of four had a lot of fun because he adjusted the pace for us and made sure we were all comfortable on the scooters. Ronnie explained the history of Barcelona and my teenage sons really enjoyed it. 10/10 would recommend. We would definitely use them again!
author: jessicapN5826NK

title: 3-hour Segway tour of Barcelona with Robotcity
text:
Thank you so much to Ronnie and Robot City for giving us an unforgettable experience touring Barcelona on a Segway. It was our first time and with 2 children, we were naturally very nervous however, Ronnie treated us all with patience, attentiveness throughout ensuring that we were all safe and feeling comfortable and confident. The 3-hour tour just wasn’t enough and easily could have done the whole day on that funtastic machine.

author: IvonyS

title: The best tour we did in Spain!
text:
The tour was excellent, the guide took us through unique places with panoramic views, a lot of history, and lots of information. But within an informal environment that made you feel very comfortable.
Pau, the guide, was the key to the success of the tour, he really knows a lot and never stops showing you curious and emblematic places in Barcelona.
author: Voyage818702

title: Great experience!
text: Tony our guide was excellent. We enjoyed riding around and hearing about all the sights. He even took pictures of us at a couple of the stops. Would recommend highly.
author: Julie G

title: A great experience
text:
we had so much fun. 
Three full hours of information and descriptions of what we were seeing
Our guide ensured a place to sit for my frequent rests
Our guide assured us that we were safe and going at a pace to make us comfortable
We loved our day- thank you
author: 649janet

title: Brilliant Way of Seeing Barcelona
text:
I would absolutely recommend this tour. I’ve been to Barcelona twice before but this tour gave me a fabulous view of the town that I’d never seen before. I was with friends and our teenage sons, everyone had a great time, although the dad’s bottled it and we went on scooters not Segway’s ! 
Zarina and her colleague were brilliant guides - Zarina, when you get a chance can you please send us the pics you took of the group ?
author: 568milesn

title: Tour with Zarina
text:
We were lucky and were allowed to jet through Barcelona in threes. 
Zarina was able to explain a lot to us even though half the city was locked down due to the beginning of the unrest. The advantage: we were able to drive partly undisturbed on the road because the police had blocked everything anyway.

We still saw the most important sights. 

Highly recommended!
author: Rainer_Ulm

title: Electric bike tour was fantastic
text: We had a fantastic time doing the Mont Tejuik tour. Zarina was tour guide. Lovely photos taken by Zarina and very informative but be careful if using electric bike downhill
author: Meena50

title: Wonderful tour, wonderful experience!
text: Zarina was our guide and we had so much fun with her.  My wife and I really enjoy segway tours and this one was exceptional.  My college-age daughter was with us also and it was her first time on a segway.  She was a bit nervous at first, but enjoyed the tour.  We loved seeing Barcelona  and enjoyed learning about the architecture.   Highly recommended!
author: jeff-h-reviews
